   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "\n",
    "policies = pd.read_csv('Analyzed_Policies.csv')\n",
    "apps = pd.read_csv('appmicroscope_policies.csv')\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Apps shape:\", apps.shape)\n",
    "print(\"Policies shape:\", policies.shape)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "a3a434ed",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Merged shape: (1694, 139)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "df = policies.merge(\n",
    "    apps,\n",
    "    on=[\"app_id\", \"app_name\"],\n",
    "    how=\"left\",\n",
    "    suffixes=(\"_pol\", \"_app\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Merged shape:\", df.shape)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "d710a168",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "disclosure_cols = [\n",
    "    \"data_collection_disclosure\",\n",
    "    \"data_use_purpose_specification\",\n",
    "    \"third_party_sharing_disclosure\",\n",
    "    \"tracking_technologies_disclosure\",\n",
    "    \"data_retention_policy\",\n",
    "    \"user_data_rights\",\n",
    "    \"data_security_encryption\",\n",
    "    \"parental_consent_mechanism\",\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"disclosure_score\"] = df[disclosure_cols].sum(axis=1)\n",
    "df[\"disclosure_pct\"] = df[\"disclosure_score\"] / len(disclosure_cols)\n"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
    "\n",
    "X = df_compliance.fillna(0).astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42)\n",
    "df[\"compliance_cluster\"] = kmeans.fit_predict(X)\n",
    "\n",
    "cluster_summary = df.groupby(\"compliance_cluster\")[compliance_cols].mean()\n",
    "cluster_summary\n"
   ]
  },

    "## Compliance Archetypes Summary\n",
    "\n",
    "| Cluster | Type | Key traits |\n",
    "|--------|------|------------|\n",
    "| 0 | Minimal / symbolic | Almost no disclosures |\n",
    "| 1 | General compliance | Strong general disclosures, no parental consent |\n",
    "| 2 | Full compliance | High disclosure across all categories |\n",
    "| 3 | Rights-heavy template | Strong legal rights/security, weak data-practice transparency |\n"
   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "b4caa442",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Symbolic Compliance test?\n",
    "\n",
    "Define symbolic compliance as:\n",
    "- Policy exists\n",
    "- Core identity + data collection disclosed\n",
    "- But rights/consent missing"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "f07b19a7",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Symbolic compliance rate: 11.4 %\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Define symbolic compliance as policies that disclose data collection\n",
    "# but fail to include critical protections like parental consent and data retention\n",
    "df[\"symbolic_compliance\"] = (\n",
    "    df[\"data_collection_disclosure\"] &\n",
    "    ~df[\"parental_consent_mechanism\"] &\n",
    "    ~df[\"data_retention_policy\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "symbolic_rate = df[\"symbolic_compliance\"].mean() * 100\n",
    "print(\"Symbolic compliance rate:\", round(symbolic_rate, 1), \"%\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",

   "source": [

   ],
   "source": [
    "coppa_cols = [\n",
    "    \"parental_consent_mechanism\",\n",
    "    \"coppa_mentions\",\n",
    "    \"coppa_claims_compliance\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "general_cols = [\n",
    "    \"data_collection_disclosure\",\n",
    "    \"data_use_purpose_specification\",\n",
    "    \"third_party_sharing_disclosure\",\n",
    "    \"data_security_encryption\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "coppa_rate = df[coppa_cols].mean() * 100\n",
    "general_rate = df[general_cols].mean() * 100\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"COPPA-related disclosure rates:\")\n",
    "print(coppa_rate.round(1))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nGeneral disclosure rates:\")\n",
    "print(general_rate.round(1))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "16879ec6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## what predicts high compliance? ##"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "6c6f968f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Optimization terminated successfully.\n",
      "         Current function value: 0.688065\n",
      "         Iterations 4\n",
      "                           Logit Regression Results                           \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:        high_compliance   No. Observations:                 1072\n",
      "Model:                          Logit   Df Residuals:                     1069\n",
      "Method:                           MLE   Df Model:                            2\n",
      "Date:                Wed, 11 Feb 2026   Pseudo R-squ.:                0.005082\n",
      "Time:                        15:08:16   Log-Likelihood:                -737.61\n",
      "converged:                       True   LL-Null:                       -741.37\n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust   LLR p-value:                   0.02311\n",
      "=================================================================================\n",
      "                    coef    std err          z      P>|z|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const            -0.1616      0.142     -1.137      0.256      -0.440       0.117\n",
      "log_downloads    -0.0214      0.015     -1.445      0.149      -0.050       0.008\n",
      "log_reviews       0.0481      0.019      2.528      0.011       0.011       0.085\n",
      "=================================================================================\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"high_compliance\"] = (df[\"disclosure_score\"] >= 6).astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = df.dropna(subset=[\"downloads\", \"reviews\"]).copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_downloads\"] = np.log1p(reg_df[\"downloads\"])\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_reviews\"] = np.log1p(reg_df[\"reviews\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "X = reg_df[[\"log_downloads\", \"log_reviews\"]]\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "\n",
    "y = reg_df[\"high_compliance\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "model = sm.Logit(y, X).fit()\n",
    "print(model.summary())\n"
   ]
  }
 ],
